class.name: SteamOwnershipChallengeStore
class.brief_description: Trusted durable store for one-time encrypted ownership challenges.
class.description: Inject this adapter through [member SteamPublisherSettings.ownership_challenge_store]. The backend issues a cryptographically random challenge for a specific outstanding request and persists its app, expiry, and any expected account binding. Pass that outstanding challenge to [method SteamPublisherAuth.verify_ownership]. A shared store must serialize the same challenge across all backend workers.

method.name: _consume
method.description: Atomically matches the exact backend-issued challenge and AppID, verifies the record is unexpired and unused, checks its request and expected-account bindings, and retires it before returning [code]true[/code]. [param steam_id] is the verified ticket account. Times use Unix seconds. Return [code]false[/code] when any check fails. Keep challenge bytes and account identifiers out of logs.
